details.description: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct is the flagship instruction-tuned model in Alibaba's Qwen2.5-Coder family, open-sourced by the Qwen team on November 12, 2024. This entry covers it with its extended 131,072-token context window, reached via YaRN scaling from a 32,768-token native window, per Qwen's model card. It is tuned for code generation, code reasoning, and code fixing while retaining general language and math ability.
advantages: Supports up to 131,072 tokens of context via YaRN scaling, extended from a 32,768-token native window, per Qwen's model card.
Scores 73.7 on the Aider code-editing benchmark, per Qwen's Qwen2.5-Coder family announcement.
Scores 65.9 on McEval, a multi-programming-language code generation benchmark, per Qwen's family announcement.
Scores 75.2 on MdEval, a multi-language code-debugging benchmark, per Qwen's family announcement.
Pretrained on 5.5 trillion tokens of source code, text-code grounding data, and synthetic data, per Qwen's model card.
disadvantages: Text-only input and output, with no vision or audio support.
Qwen's own documentation notes vLLM's static YaRN implementation may affect performance on shorter texts once long-context scaling is enabled.
use_cases: Understanding, reviewing, or refactoring large codebases and multi-file repositories that need long context.
Code generation, completion, and refactoring across multiple programming languages.
Building coding agents and code-focused conversational assistants.

notes: Same underlying model as qwen2p5-coder-32b-instruct, served here with the extended 131,072-token context window, which matches this entry's catalog facts.
